people.propertyResponsibilityNote: MREC lists Bethesda Marriott in its portfolio; no public source names Jeff Mullen as the property-assigned asset manager for this hotel.

people.recommendationRationale: Use for ownership / investment / sponsor-level outreach. Prefer asset-management contacts first when seeking property commercial dialogue.

people.title: VP, Asset Management and Investments
people.propertyResponsibilityNote: Public sources confirm she leads asset management / investments for MREC and that Bethesda is in the MREC portfolio. No public source assigns her as the named property lead for Bethesda Marriott specifically.

people.recommendationRationale: Suggested first contact for owner-side / asset-management outreach because the role matches property stewardship better than CEO seniority alone. Property responsibility is inferred from portfolio + role, not confirmed by a Bethesda-specific assignment.
